name: Popover
description:
The Popover component is used to show detailed information inside a pop-up, anchored to a trigger or to another element.

Use the default `<Popover>` with a `trigger` to render the trigger, positioner and content for you, or compose the primitives for full structural control. `Popover.Header`, `Popover.Body` and `Popover.Footer` lay out the content with padding that follows the `size` variant. Set `usage="arrow"` to show an arrow tip.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction that renders the trigger, the positioner and the content, with an optional arrow

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that toggles the popover. It is rendered as the trigger (`Popover.Trigger asChild`), so pass a single element such as a `Button`.

props.name: usage
props.description: Set to `arrow` to show an arrow tip pointing at the trigger.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Provides the Popover context and recipe variants to its parts. Renders no element.

props.name: size
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

props.name: onRequestDismiss
props.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

props.name: persistentElements
props.description: Returns the persistent elements that: - should not have pointer-events disabled - should not trigger the dismiss event

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the popover should be modal. When set to `true`: - interaction with outside elements will be disabled - only popover content will be visible to screen readers - scrolling is blocked - focus is trapped within the popover

props.name: portalled
props.description: Whether the popover is portalled. This will proxy the tabbing behavior regardless of the DOM position of the popover content.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to automatically set focus on the first focusable content within the popover when opened.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: The element to focus on when the popover is opened. Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the popover is closed.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the popover was opened.

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the user clicks outside of the popover.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the escape key is pressed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Function invoked when the popover opens or closes

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the popover

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial open state of the popover when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the open state of the popover.

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The controlled trigger value

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description: The initial trigger value when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: onTriggerValueChange
props.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

props.name: present
props.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

props.name: onEnterComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: hideMode
props.description: How to hide content when mounted but not present. - `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive. - `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: skipAnimationOnMount
props.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

Moves focus to the next focusable element within the content.
Note: If there are no focusable elements, focus is moved to the next focusable element after the trigger..

Note: If there are no focusable elements, focus is moved to the trigger..
